name: Brew Kopi O
blurb: Coffee powder and water. It is plain, hot, and enough to keep moving.

name: Mix Kopi Sachet
blurb: One sachet and whatever water is safe enough to spare.

name: Mix Milo
blurb: Milo powder and water. Not fancy, but it puts something useful in you.

name: Purify Water
blurb: Tablets and twenty minutes turn a bottle of murk into something safe.

name: Boil Water
blurb: Slower than tablets and it costs you fuel — fuel also counts hard toward evac readiness.

name: Tear Dressings
blurb: Rags torn into strips. It will stop the bleeding — it will not stop what gets in afterwards.

name: Lash a Knife Spear
blurb: A kitchen knife taped to a length of timber. Keeps them at arm’s length.

name: Lash a Cleaver Spear
blurb: Heavier at the tip than a knife spear, and it bites deeper for it.

name: Lash a Parang Spear
blurb: The best of them — and it costs you the best blade you own.

name: Strip for Parts
blurb: Scrap is heavy and worth nothing. Parts are light and repair things.

name: Reload Shells
blurb: Handloading. Ugly, slow, and the only ammunition anyone still makes.

name: Stitch a Sleeping Bag
blurb: Rags and tape into something you can sleep in. Heavy, but better than the floor.

name: Laminate an EZ-Link Knife
blurb: Four spent cards and a scrap edge. STA will not take them as tribute anymore.

name: Brew Kopi C
blurb: Coffee powder, condensed milk, and water. Murky water makes a risky cup.

name: Cook Maggi
blurb: A brick of noodles and a bottle of water. Heat is optional. Hunger is not.

name: Mix a Milo Dinosaur
blurb: The whole tin, condensed milk, and water. Heavy tin, light cup; murky water still carries its risk.

name: Bend a Lockpick
blurb: Two scraps bent into a rake and a tensioner. One door, maybe.

name: Drive Nails Through a Bat
blurb: Ugly, loud, and it tears more than it hits. The nails bend after a while.

name: Wrap Your Hands
blurb: Rag and tape over the knuckles. It is barely anything, and it is better than nothing.

name: Lash Shin Guards
blurb: Flat scrap padded with rag and taped to the shins. Legs are what they go for low.

name: Lash a Scrap Shield
blurb: Two sheets, a zip-tied handle, and an arm that will ache by evening.

name: Cut a Padded Vest
blurb: Foam soaks a bite better than it soaks a blade. You will miss it at bedtime.

name: Beat Out a Scrap Helm
blurb: A bucket of hammered plate with rag inside. You will not hear much coming.

name: Rivet a Scrap Plate Vest
blurb: Plate over rag over you. It stops teeth. It also announces every step you take.

name: Cut a Tarp Poncho
blurb: A head hole and taped seams. Dry and drab — but that tarp was your roof.

name: Strap the Torch to Your Head
blurb: The same light, and your off hand back. Worth an hour of fiddling with zip ties.
